title: poll.open
description: host → server. The host starts one round of the GO/NO-GO polling ritual. The server calls the consoles one at a time in the given order: each connected player is called once, at the position of the first of their roles in order, and answers for all their roles. The host owns the surrounding flow: after a round with any NO-GO it shows the 15 s discussion and opens round 2; after two NO-GO rounds it opens a REVIEW vote offering Rework (§6.9).

pollId.description: New poll id, never used before in this room.

round.description: Round number of this poll within the review (1 = first poll, 2 = re-poll).

order.description: Consoles in call order. Roles not listed are not called.

perCallMs.description: Answer window per call in milliseconds. Use 5000 (scaled by the server ×1.5 when `a11y.slowTimers`).

PollId.description: GO/NO-GO poll identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room.

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.
